title.zh: 每套皮肤用上自己的曲风配图，桌面端也开始展示
title.en: Each skin uses its own genre artwork, and the desktop shows it too

highlights.zh: 每套皮肤显示对应曲风配图（六套皮肤各 159 张，此前界面一直只用共享图）；缺图时自动退回共享图。
highlights.en: Every skin shows its own genre cover — six skins of 159 images the UI had never used — falling back to the shared image when one is missing.

highlights.zh: 桌面端新增三处：曲风详情头图、探索卡片缩略图、对比列头；开屏按钮改为只显示中文。
highlights.en: Three new desktop placements: the genre detail hero, explore-card thumbnails and the compare columns. The start button is Chinese-only now.
